name: Team Rocket’s Kecleon

abilities.name: Spy Ops
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at a random card from your opponent’s hand.

attacks.name: Hit and Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavor:
It changes color to blend in with its surroundings
in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its
belly pattern disappear, however.
